label: Updated 8 PM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Sentry Sponsors Torrey Pines
items.text: Sentry Insurance becomes title sponsor of the PGA Tour event at Torrey Pines, renaming it The Sentry and scheduling it Jan. 27-30 with the final round on Saturday.

items.headline: LSU’s Near-Record Rally
items.text: LSU overcame a 17-shot deficit with an 18-under 270 round to make the NCAA Championship 54-hole cut, rising to T-12 and closing within three shots of eighth place.
